purpose: Prevent DWG CIRCLE and ARC output from serializing invalid centers, thickness values, or extrusion directions.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.wireMapping: Both records carry a center, thickness and extrusion. ARC and CIRCLE use WCS center data and a nonzero WCS plane normal in the native model.

nativeContract.source: Autodesk ObjectARX AcDbCircle and AcDbArc method references
nativeContract.requirements: Circle/arc normals are nonzero WCS vectors; center and thickness setters reject unacceptable input.

implementation.behavior: A shared DWG writer admission check now requires finite center coordinates, finite thickness, finite positive radius, finite normal coordinates and a nonzero normal. ARC also requires finite start and end parameters. Values are checked before record staging.
implementation.scope: Writer admission only; DWG parsing remains unchanged.

generatedControls.failureRetry: Every refusal preserves a seeded destination; corrected same-writer output reads back exact center, normal, thickness and radius with zero entity/object parse failures.
generatedControls.fixturePolicy: All input drawings are authored by the test in scratch storage; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

limitations: These generated controls prove bounded writer refusal and retry/readback only; source prevalence, native rendering and whole-document qualification remain open.
The broader P6 version/schema/no-loss audit remains open.
supportClaimEffect: Closes bounded DWG CIRCLE/ARC writer geometry-admission gaps; no broad DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
